description: Wait until an email arrives at an address and return it. Call this right after you trigger an email (submitted a sign-up form, asked for a login code or a password reset). Pass the `since` from create_inbox; only email received strictly after `since` is returned, so you never pick up an older message. To wait for the next email to the same address, pass the previous email's receivedAt as `since`. Set extract to "otp" to get the verification code, or "links" to get the URLs (magic links, confirm links). Returns status "received" with the email (text cut at 4000 characters; get_email has the full body), or status "timeout" when nothing arrived in time: then call wait_for_email again with the same `since`.

address.description: The address to wait on, e.g. from create_inbox.

extract.description: "otp": also return the verification code; "links": also return the links; "none" (default): just the email.

since.description: ISO timestamp from create_inbox (or a previous email's receivedAt). Without it, mail from the last 60 seconds counts.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait, in seconds (default 60, max 300).

name: wait_for_email
title: Wait for email
